name: Your Company
tagline: Rehabilitation and orthopaedics: getting you moving again, without rushing and without miracle promises

seo.title: Your Company — rehabilitation and orthopaedics in Tashkent
seo.description: Recovery after injuries and surgery, back and neck pain, exercise therapy and massage. An initial consultation with assessment is 250,000 UZS, with programmes of 4–8 weeks.
seo.answer: Your Company is a rehabilitation and orthopaedics centre at 62 Babur Street in Tashkent, open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 to 20:00. An initial consultation with a rehabilitation doctor, including assessment and tests, is 250,000 UZS; an exercise therapy session with an instructor is 180,000 UZS and a therapeutic back massage 150,000 UZS. After the assessment you get a 4–8 week programme, with progress checked every two weeks.

sections.title: Moving without pain is a skill
sections.subtitle: We work out where the pain comes from and rebuild strength and mobility step by step, with a doctor, an instructor and a clear plan over several weeks.

sections.label: About
sections.title: We treat with movement, not just procedures
sections.text: Your Company brings together rehabilitation doctors, orthopaedists and exercise therapists. We start with a detailed assessment: how you stand, walk and bend, and where movement is limited. Then we build an exercise programme you do with an instructor in the gym and on your own at home. Massage and physiotherapy support the exercises; they don’t replace them.

sections.label: What we treat
sections.title: What people come in with
sections.intro: Prices are per visit. Programme length depends on your assessment.

items.title: Neck pain
items.text: Desk posture, tension headaches, numb hands.

items.title: Shoulder
items.text: Limited arm lift, recovery after a dislocation.

items.title: Lower back and discs
items.text: Low back pain, disc bulges and herniations without acute nerve symptoms.

items.title: Knee
items.text: After ligament injuries or arthroscopy, and runner’s knee.

items.title: Foot and ankle
items.text: Flat feet, heel spurs, after sprains.

items.title: Posture in teens
items.text: Grade I–II scoliosis and slouching, in small groups.

items.title: Assessment
items.text: 60 minutes with a rehab doctor: your history, movement and strength tests, and imaging referrals if needed.

items.title: Calm the pain
items.text: Weeks 1–2: gentle exercise, massage and physiotherapy where indicated.

items.title: Rebuild strength
items.text: Weeks 3–6: strength and stability work, checked every two weeks.

items.title: On your own
items.text: A home programme and a follow-up a month later.

items.quote: After knee surgery I was afraid to put weight on my leg. Six weeks later I’m back to 5 km walks, and I know which exercises to keep doing.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Most people notice the first changes after 2–3 weeks of regular sessions, but it depends on the problem; the doctor will be more precise after the assessment.
Yes: acute inflammation, fever and some heart conditions. That’s why sessions only start after a doctor’s assessment.
